name: a keyword stutters into place behind glitched echoes
looks: A section label types on in a corner. Then a single word hard-cuts into the centre of the frame, solid and glowing, while several larger outlined copies of the same word hover around it, their edges split with a faint colour fringe, and small coloured pixels blink in and out across the field.
build: A small mono section-label layer types on in the top-left. The main word is a solid centred layer; 3-4 stroke-only duplicate copies sit at larger, offset scales behind it with a constant 1-2px chromatic-aberration offset on their edges; seeded pixel sprites fade in/out independently on short loops, unsynced from the word's beat.
sound: A short digital stutter burst as the word lands, with a few quiet random blips under the hold.
prompt: Label the section with a small corner tag, then hard-cut a single keyword into frame solid and bright, ringed by larger outline-only echoes of itself with a faint colour-split edge and a scatter of drifting pixels, so the word reads as glitched into existence rather than simply typed on.
